/**
 * Register the 'wpbp-content' ability category.
 */
add_action( 'wp_abilities_api_categories_init', 'wpbp_register_content_ability_category' );

function wpbp_register_content_ability_category() {
	if ( ! function_exists( 'wp_register_ability_category' ) ) {
		return;
	}

	wp_register_ability_category(
		'wpbp-content',
		array(
			'label'       => __( 'Content', 'wpbp' ),
			'description' => __( 'Abilities related to content analysis and manipulation.', 'wpbp' ),
		)
	);
}

/**
 * Register the 'wpbp/count-words' ability.
 */
add_action( 'wp_abilities_api_init', 'wpbp_register_count_words_ability' );

function wpbp_register_count_words_ability() {
	if ( ! function_exists( 'wp_register_ability' ) ) {
		return;
	}

	wp_register_ability(
		'wpbp/count-words',
		array(
			'label'               => __( 'Count Words', 'wpbp' ),
			'description'         => __( 'Counts the number of words in the supplied text.', 'wpbp' ),
			'category'            => 'wpbp-content',
			'input_schema'        => array(
				'type'                 => 'object',
				'properties'           => array(
					'text' => array(
						'type'        => 'string',
						'description' => __( 'The text in which to count words.', 'wpbp' ),
					),
				),
				'required'             => array( 'text' ),
				'additionalProperties' => false,
			),
			'output_schema'       => array(
				'type'        => 'integer',
				'description' => __( 'The number of words found in the text.', 'wpbp' ),
				'minimum'     => 0,
			),
			'execute_callback'    => 'wpbp_count_words_execute',
			'permission_callback' => function () {
				return current_user_can( 'read' );
			},
			'meta'                => array(
				'show_in_rest' => true,
			),
		)
	);
}

/**
 * Execute callback for the 'wpbp/count-words' ability.
 *
 * @param array $input Input data containing the 'text' key.
 * @return int Number of words.
 */
function wpbp_count_words_execute( $input ) {
	$text = isset( $input['text'] ) ? (string) $input['text'] : '';

	$text = wp_strip_all_tags( $text );
	$text = trim( $text );

	if ( '' === $text ) {
		return 0;
	}

	$words = preg_split( '/\s+/u', $text, -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY );

	if ( false === $words ) {
		return 0;
	}

	return (int) count( $words );
}

/**
 * Unregister an ability through the Abilities API and verify it is gone.
 *
 * @param string $ability_name The name of the ability to unregister.
 * @return bool True only when a WP_Ability instance was returned and the ability is no longer registered.
 */
function wpbp_abilities_api_008( string $ability_name ): bool {
	if ( ! function_exists( 'wp_unregister_ability' ) || ! function_exists( 'wp_has_ability' ) ) {
		return false;
	}

	$result = wp_unregister_ability( $ability_name );

	if ( ! ( $result instanceof WP_Ability ) ) {
		return false;
	}

	return ! wp_has_ability( $ability_name );
}

function wpbp_abilities_api_013(): void {
	add_filter(
		'wp_register_ability_args',
		static function ( $args, $name = '' ) {
			if ( ! is_array( $args ) ) {
				return $args;
			}

			if ( ! is_string( $name ) || 0 !== strpos( $name, 'wpbp-forced/' ) ) {
				return $args;

				$args['meta'] = array();
			}

			$args['meta']['show_in_rest'] = true;

			return $args;
		},
		10,
		2
	);
}

<?php
/**
 * Store a value as a transient and confirm it can be retrieved.
 *
 * @param string $key        Transient key.
 * @param string $value      Value to store.
 * @param int    $expiration Expiration time in seconds.
 * @return bool True only when the retrieved value matches the stored value.
 */
function wpbp_caching_004( string $key, string $value, int $expiration ): bool {
	$stored = set_transient( $key, $value, $expiration );

	if ( ! $stored ) {
		return false;
	}

	$retrieved = get_transient( $key );

	if ( false === $retrieved ) {
		return false;
	}

	return $retrieved === $value;
}

<?php
/**
 * Create a Subscriber user with the supplied login and return the WP_User object.
 *
 * @param string $login The desired user login.
 * @return WP_User|WP_Error WP_User on success, WP_Error on failure.
 */
function wpbp_comments_users_001( string $login ): WP_User|WP_Error {
	$login = sanitize_user( $login, true );

	if ( '' === $login ) {
		return new WP_Error( 'invalid_login', __( 'A valid user login is required.', 'wpbp' ) );
	}

	if ( ! validate_username( $login ) ) {
		return new WP_Error( 'invalid_username', __( 'The supplied username is not valid.', 'wpbp' ) );
	}

	if ( username_exists( $login ) ) {
		return new WP_Error( 'username_exists', __( 'That username already exists.', 'wpbp' ) );
	}

	$user_id = wp_insert_user(
		array(
			'user_login' => $login,
			'user_pass'  => wp_generate_password( 24, true, true ),
			'role'       => 'subscriber',
		)
	);

	if ( is_wp_error( $user_id ) ) {
		return $user_id;
	}

	$user = get_userdata( $user_id );

	if ( ! ( $user instanceof WP_User ) ) {
		return new WP_Error( 'user_retrieval_failed', __( 'The user was created but could not be retrieved.', 'wpbp' ) );
	}

	return $user;
}

 *
 * @param string $meta_key   The user meta key to search.

function wpbp_comments_users_002( string $meta_key, string $meta_value ): array {

/**
 * Schedule a one-time event for the 'wpbp_single_event' hook at the given
 * timestamp, only if the hook is not already scheduled.
 *
 * @param int $timestamp Unix timestamp at which the event should run.
 * @return bool True if the event was scheduled, false if it was already
 *              scheduled or scheduling failed.
 */
function wpbp_cron_001( int $timestamp ): bool {
	$hook = 'wpbp_single_event';

	if ( false !== wp_next_scheduled( $hook ) ) {
		return false;
	}

	$result = wp_schedule_single_event( $timestamp, $hook );

	return true === $result;
}

}

<?php
/**
 * Build a safely parameterized SQL query for the WordPress-prefixed
 * `wpbp_database_002` custom table.
 *
 * Selects `id` where `visibility` = 'public' and `title` contains the
 * supplied term as literal text (LIKE wildcards % and _ are escaped).
 *
 * @param string $term Literal search term.
 * @return string Prepared SQL query string (not query results).
 */
function wpbp_database_002( string $term ): string {
	global $wpdb;

	// Table name with WordPress prefix, treated as an identifier.
	$table = $wpdb->prefix . 'wpbp_database_002';

	// Escape identifiers: strip backticks by doubling them, then wrap in backticks.
	$quote_identifier = static function ( string $identifier ): string {
		return '`' . str_replace( '`', '``', $identifier ) . '`';
	};

	$table_sql      = $quote_identifier( $table );
	$id_sql         = $quote_identifier( 'id' );
	$visibility_sql = $quote_identifier( 'visibility' );
	$title_sql      = $quote_identifier( 'title' );

	// Escape LIKE wildcards (%, _ and backslash) so they are treated literally.
	$like = '%' . $wpdb->esc_like( $term ) . '%';

	// Identifiers are inserted after quoting; values are bound via prepare().
	$sql = "SELECT {$id_sql} FROM {$table_sql} WHERE {$visibility_sql} = %s AND {$title_sql} LIKE %s";

	return $wpdb->prepare( $sql, 'public', $like );
}

/**
 * Serialize a parsed block array back to WordPress block markup.
 *
 * @param array $block A parsed block array (as returned by parse_blocks()).
 * @return string The serialized block markup.
 */
function wpbp_gb_block_api_004( array $block ): string {
	if ( ! function_exists( 'serialize_block' ) ) {
		return '';
	}

	// Normalize the block structure so serialize_block() receives all expected keys.
	$defaults = array(
		'blockName'    => null,
		'attrs'        => array(),
		'innerBlocks'  => array(),
		'innerHTML'    => '',
		'innerContent' => array(),
	);

	$block = array_merge( $defaults, $block );

	if ( ! is_array( $block['attrs'] ) ) {
		$block['attrs'] = array();
	}

	if ( ! is_array( $block['innerBlocks'] ) ) {
		$block['innerBlocks'] = array();
	}

	if ( ! is_string( $block['innerHTML'] ) ) {
		$block['innerHTML'] = '';
	}

	if ( ! is_array( $block['innerContent'] ) ) {
		$block['innerContent'] = array();
	}

	// If innerContent is empty but innerHTML exists, and there are no inner blocks, rebuild it.
	if ( empty( $block['innerContent'] ) && '' !== $block['innerHTML'] && empty( $block['innerBlocks'] ) ) {
		$block['innerContent'] = array( $block['innerHTML'] );
	}

	return (string) serialize_block( $block );
}

<?php
/**
 * Returns a safe Interactivity API context attribute for the supplied context data
 * in the 'wpbp/store' namespace.
 *
 * @param array $context The context data.
 * @return string The complete data-wp-context attribute string.
 */
function wpbp_gb_interactivity_api_002( array $context ): string {
	if ( function_exists( 'wp_interactivity_data_wp_context' ) ) {
		return wp_interactivity_data_wp_context( $context, 'wpbp/store' );
	}

	// Fallback for environments where the helper is unavailable.
	$json = wp_json_encode( $context, JSON_HEX_TAG | JSON_HEX_AMP | JSON_HEX_APOS | JSON_HEX_QUOT );

	if ( false === $json || '' === $json ) {
		$json = '{}';
	}

	return 'data-wp-context=\'' . esc_attr( $json ) . '\'';
}

<?php
/**
 * Increment a numeric post meta counter and return the new value.
 *
 * @param int    $post_id  The post ID.
 * @param string $meta_key The meta key holding the counter.
 * @return int The incremented count, or the current count if persisting failed.
 *             Returns 0 for invalid input.
 */
function wpbp_post_meta_001( int $post_id, string $meta_key ): int {
    $post_id  = absint( $post_id );
    $meta_key = trim( $meta_key );

    if ( $post_id <= 0 || '' === $meta_key ) {
        return 0;
    }

    if ( ! get_post( $post_id ) ) {
        return 0;
    }

    $current = get_post_meta( $post_id, $meta_key, true );
    $current = is_numeric( $current ) ? (int) $current : 0;

    $new_count = $current + 1;

    $updated = update_post_meta( $post_id, $meta_key, $new_count );

    if ( false === $updated ) {
        return $current;
    }

    return $new_count;
}

<?php
/**
 * Add category terms to a post without removing existing category assignments.
 *
 * @param int   $post_id  The post ID.
 * @param array $term_ids Array of category term IDs to add.
 * @return array The term_taxonomy_ids reported by WordPress, or an empty array on failure.
 */
function wpbp_post_types_taxonomy_006( int $post_id, array $term_ids ): array {
	if ( $post_id <= 0 ) {
		return array();
	}

	// Sanitize term IDs: cast to integers, remove zeros/negatives and duplicates.
	$term_ids = array_values(
		array_unique(
			array_filter(
				array_map( 'intval', $term_ids ),
				static function ( $id ) {
					return $id > 0;
				}
			)
		)
	);

	if ( empty( $term_ids ) ) {
		return array();
	}

	// Append (true) so existing category relationships are preserved.
	$result = wp_set_object_terms( $post_id, $term_ids, 'category', true );

	if ( is_wp_error( $result ) || ! is_array( $result ) ) {
		return array();
	}

	return array_map( 'intval', $result );
}

 * @param array  $tag_slugs     Array of tag slugs (any of them match).
 * @return WP_Query
 */
function wpbp_queries_004( string $category_slug, array $tag_slugs ): WP_Query {
	$category_slug = sanitize_title( $category_slug );

	$tag_slugs = array_values(
		array_filter(
			array_map( 'sanitize_title', array_map( 'strval', $tag_slugs ) ),
			static function ( $slug ) {
				return '' !== $slug;
			}
		)
	);
	$tag_slugs = array_values( array_unique( $tag_slugs ) );

	$tax_query = array(
		'relation' => 'AND',
		array(
			'taxonomy'         => 'category',
			'field'            => 'slug',
			'terms'            => array( $category_slug ),
			'operator'         => 'IN',
			'include_children' => true,
		),
	);

	if ( ! empty( $tag_slugs ) ) {
		$tax_query[] = array(
			'taxonomy' => 'post_tag',
			'field'    => 'slug',
			'terms'    => $tag_slugs,
			'operator' => 'IN',
		);
	} else {
		// No valid tags supplied: nothing can satisfy "in either of the tags".
		return new WP_Query(
			array(
				'post_type'      => 'post',
				'post_status'    => 'publish',
				'post__in'       => array( 0 ),
				'no_found_rows'  => true,
			)
		);
	}

	$args = array(
		'post_type'           => 'post',
		'post_status'         => 'publish',
		'ignore_sticky_posts' => true,
		'tax_query'           => $tax_query, // phpcs:ignore WordPress.DB.SlowDBQuery.slow_db_query_tax_query
	);

	return new WP_Query( $args );

/**
 * Preload the post meta cache, then read a single meta value from many posts.
 *
 * @param int[]  $post_ids Array of post IDs.
 * @param string $meta_key Meta key to retrieve.
 * @return array Associative array of post ID => single meta value.
 */
function wpbp_queries_010( array $post_ids, string $meta_key ): array {
	$post_ids = array_values( array_unique( array_filter( array_map( 'absint', $post_ids ) ) ) );

	if ( empty( $post_ids ) || '' === $meta_key ) {
		return array();
	}

	// Prime the post meta cache with a single query for all posts.
	update_meta_cache( 'post', $post_ids );

	$results = array();

	foreach ( $post_ids as $post_id ) {
		// Reads from the primed cache; no additional queries per post.
		$results[ $post_id ] = get_post_meta( $post_id, $meta_key, true );
	}

	return $results;
}

/**
 * Ensure arbitrary callback data is converted to a WP_REST_Response
 * and return its status and data.
 *
 * @param array $data Arbitrary callback data.
 * @return array {
 *     @type int   $status HTTP status code of the response.
 *     @type mixed $data   Data contained in the response.
 * }
 */
function wpbp_rest_api_006( array $data ): array {
	$response = rest_ensure_response( $data );

	if ( is_wp_error( $response ) ) {
		$error_data = $response->get_error_data();
		$status     = is_array( $error_data ) && isset( $error_data['status'] )
			? (int) $error_data['status']

			'status' => $status,
			'data'   => array(
				'code'    => $response->get_error_code(),
				'message' => $response->get_error_message(),
			),
		);
	}

	return array(
		'status' => (int) $response->get_status(),
		'data'   => $response->get_data(),
	);
}

<?php
/**
 * Returns the correct REST API authorization status codes for
 * logged-out and logged-in users.
 *
 * WordPress' rest_authorization_required_code() returns:
 * - 401 for logged-out users
 * - 403 for logged-in users
 *
 * @return array{
 *     logged_in: bool,
 *     status: int,
 *     logged_out_status: int,
 *     logged_in_status: int
 * }
 */
function wpbp_rest_api_011(): array {
    // Status for the current user (based on the current login state).
    $current_status = (int) rest_authorization_required_code();

    $is_logged_in = function_exists( 'is_user_logged_in' ) ? is_user_logged_in() : false;

    // Compute both statuses without hard-coding a single value.
    $logged_out_status = $current_status;
    $logged_in_status  = $current_status;

    $current_user_id = function_exists( 'get_current_user_id' ) ? get_current_user_id() : 0;

    // Determine status for a logged-out user.
    if ( $is_logged_in ) {
        wp_set_current_user( 0 );
        $logged_out_status = (int) rest_authorization_required_code();
        wp_set_current_user( $current_user_id );
        $logged_in_status = (int) rest_authorization_required_code();
    } else {
        $logged_out_status = (int) rest_authorization_required_code();

        // Find a user to simulate the logged-in state, if any exists.
        $users = get_users(
            array(
                'number' => 1,
                'fields' => 'ID',
            )
        );

        if ( ! empty( $users ) ) {
            wp_set_current_user( (int) $users[0] );
            $logged_in_status = (int) rest_authorization_required_code();
            wp_set_current_user( 0 );
        } else {
            // No users available to simulate; fall back to the WordPress convention
            // using the function's own logic for a logged-in state.
            $logged_in_status = is_user_logged_in() ? $current_status : 403;
        }
    }

    return array(
        'logged_in'         => (bool) $is_logged_in,
        'status'            => $current_status,
        'logged_out_status' => $logged_out_status,
        'logged_in_status'  => $logged_in_status,
    );
}

        && ! array_key_exists( $cap, $role->capabilities );

/**
 * Returns the primitive capabilities WordPress requires for the given user
 * to edit the given post, using the meta-cap mapping (map_meta_cap).
 *
 * @param int $user_id User ID.
 * @param int $post_id Post ID.
 * @return array List of primitive capabilities required.
 */
function wpbp_roles_caps_004( int $user_id, int $post_id ): array {
	$user_id = absint( $user_id );
	$post_id = absint( $post_id );

	if ( ! $user_id || ! $post_id ) {
		return array();
	}

	if ( ! function_exists( 'map_meta_cap' ) ) {
		return array();
	}

	$post = get_post( $post_id );
	if ( ! $post ) {
		return array();
	}

	// Map the meta capability "edit_post" to primitive capabilities for this user and post.
	$caps = map_meta_cap( 'edit_post', $user_id, $post_id );

	if ( ! is_array( $caps ) ) {
		return array();
	}

	// Normalize: unique, re-indexed list of strings.
	$caps = array_values( array_unique( array_map( 'strval', $caps ) ) );

	return $caps;
}

	update_option( $option_name, $options );

	return $options;
}
